scope: Finite audit of named upstream rules/core/policy candidates and retained style/topic resources across all six repositories; not every imperative in every upstream file.
activation: Portable skill-linked documents; no hook registration, plugin installation or lifecycle activation. Unselected rule families remain reference material.

sources.rationale: Replace ECC install scripts and host namespaces with selected portable rules, explicit skill links, approved defaults, traceability and deferred activation. ECC install.sh is not bundled or required.
